function: Learned RIS phase-shift configuration (and BS beamforming vectors in F-MAPPO) jointly with task-vehicle offloading mode, minimizing average offloading delay in a multi-RIS V2X network (pp. 6-9).
system: BS with 8 receiving antennas, 3 passive reflecting RIS of 16 elements each (unit amplitude), 4 task vehicles; frequency band not stated (pp. 4, 5, 10, 12).
method: Multi-agent PPO (BS agent continuous, vehicle agents discrete) with federated averaging of actor and critic parameters across vehicles (F-MAPPO); low-complexity variant LF-MAPPO, trained online (pp. 7-9).
data_channel: Custom simulator: path loss C0*d^-alpha, Rician small-scale fading, BS-RIS line-of-sight and other links Rayleigh; 1.6 km two-way road; no 3GPP model or measurements (pp. 5, 10).
test_conditions: Training and testing in the same simulated road scenario; sweeps over number of RIS (2-4), RIS elements (8-32) and vehicle power (0.1-0.3 W); no unseen-condition test (pp. 11-12).
baselines: Variants of the proposal: centralized MAPPO (LC-MAPPO), decentralized MAPPO (LD-MAPPO), F-MAPPO; system variants without RIS or without V2V offloading; no non-learned method (pp. 10-12).
metrics: Average task processing latency, convergence versus iterations, percentage latency reduction against no-RIS and no-V2V systems (pp. 11-12).
complexity: Analytic training time complexity O(E(K+1)n_p^2 + (E/xi_f)K n_f) and space complexity O((K+1)n_p^2 + M + K n_f); no FLOPs or measured runtime (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 5: "All relevant channels utilize the Rice fading channel model," with path loss L(d)=C0 d^-alpha (Eq. 2); p. 10: BS-RIS line of sight, other links Rayleigh; custom simulator, no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured channel.
q2_support: p. 8: "the dimension of the action space (18) of the BS agent under this algorithm is" M x K + N x R, so each sweep point changes the network; p. 12: "the increase in the number of RIS also increases the burden of" training; no trained policy is tested in an unseen setting.
q3_support: p. 11: "based solutions: low-complexity algorithm based on centralized MAPPO (LC-MAPPO), low-complexity algorithm based" on decentralized MAPPO and LF-MAPPO are variants of the proposal; p. 12: "systems: a) A system where multiple RIS assistance and V2V" - NRIS and NV2V run LF-MAPPO; no non-learned baseline.
q4_support: p. 9: "The time complexity of the training process is expressed" as O(E(K+1)n_p^2 + (E/xi_f)K n_f), and the space complexity as O((K+1)n_p^2 + M + K n_f).
q5_support: p. 10: "simulation experiments were conducted using the PyTorch" toolbox in Python 3.8; no code or data link, DOI or public dataset appears in the paper, and the channels are simulated.
notes: Included under the joint rule: the BS agent learns RIS phase shifts (and beamforming vectors in F-MAPPO) while vehicle agents learn offloading modes above the physical layer (p. 7, Eqs. 18 and 21), so area 3. In the final LF-MAPPO the beamforming vector is closed form (p. 9, Eq. 31) and the learned physical-layer action is the RIS phase shift (p. 9, Eq. 29). Federated averaging runs digitally through the BS (p. 8), not over the air, so area 7 does not apply. Borderline for the reviewer: the offloading decision is above the physical layer.
